Method of Attack: Digitally-signed rootkit posing as a video driver
Downloads any payload chosen by operator
Injects downloader into legitimate svchost.exe process
Rewrites itself to disk before shutdown for persistence
Subscribes users to YouTube channels via Chrome in debugging mode
Installs browser extensions to add JavaScript, context menu options, or change default search engine
Sends Facebook friend requests and phishing messages with links to suspicious Android APKs
Steals cookies from Chrome, Chromium-based browsers, Firefox, and Edge (using EdgeCookiesView tool)
Steals Steam account credentials and game data
Uses fake software posing as pirated utilities or legitimate applications as infection vector
Impacted Systems: Browsers: Chrome, Chromium, Firefox, Opera, Edge, Internet Explorer, Baidu, Yandex
Services: Facebook, Amazon, Airbnb, Steam, YouTube
Attack Vector: Fake software posing as pirated utilities or legitimate applications (e-book readers, video players, anti-malware solutions)
Indicators of Compromise: Digitally-signed certificate issued by DigiCert for Yun Yu Health Management Consulting (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
Command and control servers pushing malware strains
About 400 hashes for DLL components used by Scranos
YouTube subscription payload URLs from C&C
Facebook phishing messages with links to suspicious Android APKs
